title: Ω1766 Evidence Map: information disorder, financial-system claims, historical records and gravity-engineering claims
method: Separate visual observations, factual claims requiring source verification, established physics, derived mathematics, and hypotheses. Do not convert narrative or political claims into facts.

observed_claims: A future voting system is described as a quantum voting system.
The image associates it with transparency, safer voting, direct democracy and equal weighting of votes.
It claims existing politics is broadly characterized by lies and corruption.
The image asks whether China, Russia and others are coordinating with the US president to eliminate a supposed NWO.
It presents this as a geopolitical hypothesis/question, not a demonstrated observation.
It references a quantum financial system narrative.

image_observations.theme: Crypto Clarity Act / quantum financial system
observed_claims: The image claims the Crypto Clarity Act is designed to legally integrate a quantum financial system into the US Treasury.
This requires direct primary-source verification against the actual legislation.
The graphic presents a causal loop: politicians create problems, media sells answers, and the public consumes the resulting narrative.
It references Post- och Inrikes Tidningar and Axel Oxenstierna and uses a 380-year continuity framing.
The graphic displays a 14 March 2001 document labelled as an agreement between Sweden and the United States concerning atmospheric climate research.
It interprets this as proof of chemtrails.
A 2500-year-old gold foundation tablet is attributed to Darius the Great and the Apadana Palace at Persepolis.
The object is presented as deliberately deposited beneath the palace foundation.
The graphic discusses historical claims involving superconductors and gravity modification.
It emphasizes reproducibility, statistical significance, controls, parameter dependence and independent replication.
It explicitly distinguishes speculative crystal-prism ideas from established physics.

physics_bridge.core_rule: Narrative intensity is not physical energy. A claim enters the physics layer only after operational definition, units, mechanism, measurement and reproducibility.

entropy_gate.state: information uncertainty reduction subject to thermodynamic consistency
entropy_gate.minimal_loop: observation -> provenance -> model -> prediction -> measurement -> update
entropy_gate.information_measure: I(X;M) > 0 when a measurement M provides information about system state X

physics_bridge.frequency_rule: Frequency is not entropy. Interference is not entropy production unless a dissipative/thermalization mechanism is specified.

historical_entropy_gate_hypothesis.definition: A historical transition where uncertainty, identity or institutional information is compressed into durable records, rituals, laws or infrastructure.
historical_entropy_gate_hypothesis.important_boundary: This is a sociological/information-theoretic hypothesis, not evidence that historical societies physically altered thermodynamic entropy through a special frequency.

research_queue: Verify the actual 2001 Sweden-US atmospheric research document and its technical scope.
Verify the exact US legislation called Crypto Clarity Act and compare the text with the QFS claim.
Verify the Darius foundation-tablet provenance through museum or archaeological primary sources.
Audit historical gravity-modification claims against independent replication literature.

omega1766_policy: Keep the chain auditable: source -> observation -> interpretation -> mathematical derivation -> test -> status.
